project.name: Pitlessie
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Pitlessie is worthwhile on a planned route, but the practical offer remains too narrow for 60+. Strict-boundary score verified sequentially on 2026-09-02. The inn is included only for its breakfast and light-lunch relevance, not full evening meals. Private Crawford Priory ruins do not become a Pitlessie attraction. No roadside verge is pinned as visitor parking.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Pitlessie has a current inn offering breakfast and daytime light meals plus a documented rural walk, but no public toilet, picnic site or dedicated visitor parking.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Verified outdoor routes can suit responsible dog visits, with close control around livestock, roads, wildlife and historic fabric.
